data.name: Shivapriya
data.gender_notes: Shivapriya is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Shivapriya is a unisex name that means 'beloved of Lord Shiva' in Sanskrit. It is often given to children born under the influence of Lord Shiva. The name Shivapriya carries the meaning “Beloved of Lord Shiva” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit, Hindi, etc. tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Shivapriya usually hope their child will grow to embody beloved of lord shiva and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Devotion and love for the divine
data.etymology: Shivapriya belongs to the Sanskrit, Hindi, etc. linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Beloved of Lord Shiva.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Shivapriya total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

data.cultural_impact: The name Shivapriya holds a significant cultural impact in Hinduism as the name symbolizes devotion and deep love for Lord Shiva, one of the primary deities in Hinduism. Lord Shiva is known as the destroyer of evil and the transformer who grants boons and bestows blessings to his devotees. The name Shivapriya reflects a deep connection and reverence for this deity.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Shivapriya holds great spiritual significance as well. It signifies the deep love and devotion towards Lord Shiva, who is believed to be the source of all creation and destruction. For those named Shivapriya or for those who use this name as a mantra, it serves as a constant reminder to seek the blessings of Lord Shiva and to strive towards the path of righteousness and spiritual growth. It is believed that those who hold Lord Shiva close to their hearts will be protected, blessed, and granted inner peace and joy. Thus, Shivapriya is not just a name, but a manifestation of love and devotion towards the ultimate reality.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Shivapriya means "Beloved of Shiva." This name embodies deep devotion and love towards the Hindu god of destruction and regeneration, Lord Shiva. It is a reminder of the transformative power of love and the divine connection between the individual soul and the universal consciousness represented by Shiva.

vedic_reference.note: This name is not found in Vedic literature, but it is a common name in Hindu culture.

historical_references.reference: Shivapriya is a name mentioned in the Hindu epic Mahabharata. She is the wife of Bhishma Pitamaha, the grandsire of the Kuru dynasty.

modern_usage.modern_context: In today's interconnected world, the name Shivapriya continues to be cherished by Hindu families globally. It is frequently featured on social media platforms where parents share their naming journeys, and Hindu name websites where expectant parents research meaningful names. The name bridges traditional Hindu values with modern Indian identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and cultural significance.
